description: sing-box 的 Windows 图形客户端 | Windows GUI client for sing-box, the universal proxy platform
notes_cn: TUN 模式需要管理员权限，应用会自行提权（resources\elevate.exe）。配置保存在 %APPDATA%\sing-box（已链接持久化），守护进程数据位于 %ProgramData%\sing-box-daemon
notes: TUN mode requires administrator privileges; the app elevates itself via resources\elevate.exe. Settings live in %APPDATA%\sing-box (linked to a persisted directory) and daemon data in %ProgramData%\sing-box-daemon
pre_install: $stage = Join-Path $dir 'stage'; $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stage -Force; Move-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir "app\$(@($fname)[0])") -Destination $stage; Expand-7zipArchive -Path (Join-Path $stage "$(@($fname)[0])") -DestinationPath $stage; Expand-7zipArchive -Path (Join-Path $stage '$PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z') -DestinationPath (Join-Path $dir 'app'); Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force
